speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRI results indicate Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), a serious opportunistic infection of the central nervous system often seen in immunocompromised patients or those on specific immunomodulators. Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, this diagnosis aligns with your clinical presentation of ataxia.
